serverInfo.name: klippa-dochorizon-mcp
serverInfo.title: Doxis AI.dp (Klippa DocHorizon) MCP by usefulapi

result.instructions: Tools for Doxis AI.dp (Klippa DocHorizon), hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which capture models are enabled in my account?"; "Which of my document jobs have finished and which are still processing?"; "Does my invoice capture model also return the VAT number?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Doxis AI.dp (Klippa DocHorizon) data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run dochorizon_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run dochorizon_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run dochorizon_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. dochorizon_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.title: List enabled capturing models
tools.description: List the document capturing models enabled for this project (financial, identity, bank statement, salary slip, generic, e-invoice, ...). Does not process a document; normally not billed. GET /document_capturing/v1/enabled_models.

tools.name: dochorizon_list_configurations
tools.title: List capturing configurations
tools.description: List the capturing configurations of a model (name, slug and the enabled components). Pass a slug as configuration_slug to a capture tool to choose which fields are extracted. Does not process a document; normally not billed. GET /document_capturing/v1/{model}/configurations.

tools.name: dochorizon_capture_financial
tools.title: Capture an invoice or receipt
tools.description: SPENDS CREDITS: extract structured data from an invoice, receipt or other financial document with the Financial model: merchant and customer, dates, totals, VAT, line items, payment details, currency, and more (as the chosen configuration enables). Uses your own Doxis AI.dp (Klippa) credits: billed per request or per page depending on the service (extra components in a configuration can add cost), at your project's price (Billing → Pricing in the platform); a new account starts with EUR 25 of free credit. Give the document as exactly one of url (public https), data_base64 (small files) or file_id (a stored file). Synchronous; for long documents use dochorizon_submit_async_capture. POST /document_capturing/v1/financial.

url.description: Public https URL of the document. Klippa downloads it (must complete within 30 seconds).

data_base64.description: The document as base64 (at most about 1.5 MB of file). Prefer url or file_id for anything bigger.

file_id.description: A Doxis AI.dp storage file id (from dochorizon_upload_file or a toolkit result).

filename.description: A name for the file (helps content-type detection).

content_type.description: MIME type, if it cannot be detected.

password.description: Password of a protected PDF. Only used for this request.

page_ranges.description: Pages to process, for example '1-3, 5', '2-last', 'first-last' (default: all pages; documents over 50 pages time out).

configuration_slug.description: Slug of a capturing configuration made in the platform (see dochorizon_list_configurations). Optional: the model's defaults apply without it.

tools.name: dochorizon_submit_async_capture
tools.title: Submit a document for asynchronous capture
tools.description: SPENDS CREDITS: queue one document for capturing and return a job_id right away; poll dochorizon_get_async_job, then read dochorizon_get_async_job_result. Use it for long documents and bursts (async jobs are not subject to the concurrent-request limit). No webhook or human review is configured. For identity, salary_slip and bank_statement the result holds personal data. Uses your own Doxis AI.dp (Klippa) credits: billed per request or per page depending on the service (extra components in a configuration can add cost), at your project's price (Billing → Pricing in the platform); a new account starts with EUR 25 of free credit. Give the document as exactly one of url (public https), data_base64 (small files) or file_id (a stored file). POST /document_capturing/v1/{model}/async.
